label: POST-HOC / DESCRIPTIVE; NavSim v1 open-loop PDM scorer on the navtrain selection sample (2,089 tokens, 30 logs, all us-nv-las-vegas-strip); refcv8-r101-s0 EMA-48,852 = ONE training seed; inference seeds s0/s1; NOT pre-registered; decides nothing

C5_shuffled_pairing_widens_CI.reading: AS WRITTEN (widens under the cluster estimator) this control FAILS: the log-cluster ratio-of-sums bootstrap sees only per-log sums, and pairing matters through the log-level covariance, which is weak here (see log_level_corr). It widens under the token-iid bootstrap, which proves the pairing carries token-level signal; that estimator is shown ONLY for that purpose and is not a valid interval (ignores log clustering).

Q1_where.estimator: independent log-cluster bootstrap (cluster = log_name, 30), B 2000, seed 7, paired on tokens, ratio-of-sums per cell; answers 'another draw of LOGS', NOT 'another training run' / 'another inference run'

>=13.89.UNDERPOWERED: n=11, logs=3: interval is not decision-grade

[0,2) x right.UNDERPOWERED: n=10, logs=3: interval is not decision-grade

[8.33,13.89) x left.UNDERPOWERED: n=23, logs=6: interval is not decision-grade

>=13.89 x straight.UNDERPOWERED: n=11, logs=3: interval is not decision-grade

DDC.rule: any decrease/increase; DDC is NOT in this scorer's PDMS (informational)

subscore_flip_counts._note: NC / DAC / TTC / EP are NOT independent: in this scorer EP is zeroed on 100 % of NC=0 / DAC=0 tokens and TTC on most NC=0 tokens, so the flip rows OVERLAP and their contributions do not add -- see failure_class_exclusive for the additive decomposition.

Q2_plan_error.note: NavSim poses at 0.5..4.0 s in the ego frame at t0 (x fwd, y left). Human = logged ego future from the inputs file. Thresholds below are committed here, post-hoc, and descriptive.

human_proximity.note: L2 to the logged human future is NOT the metric; included to show whether the plan that scores worse is also farther from the human

path_vs_progress.definition: max over the 6 knots (0.5..4 s) of the distance from the plan knot to the PRIOR polyline extended by its end ray: ~0 means the plan follows the prior's PATH and only differs in progress along it

near_identical_lt0.5m.UNDERPOWERED: n=28, logs=10: interval is not decision-grade
n=3, logs=2: interval is not decision-grade

Q2_plan_error.human_future_has_no_lead_agent_informati: The inputs file carries ego_status + the logged ego future only; agent tracks live in the Thor metric cache. 'Accelerates into the lead' vs 'brakes and is hit' is therefore NOT resolvable here -- only slower/faster than the prior and the human (UNVERIFIED mechanism).

anchor.note: refcv8 anchor TABLE is not on this machine, so anchors are compared by INDEX only (UNVERIFIED geometry); the prior has no anchor

worst10pct_share_ci95.estimator: log-cluster bootstrap re-ranking tokens inside each draw

cluster_effect_permutation_test.statistic: sum_l n_l (mean_l - mean)^2 on token gaps
cluster_effect_permutation_test.reading: p small => the gap varies BY LOG more than chance token assignment explains (cluster effect); the gap can still be everywhere AND clustered

Q4a_gating.note: A gate that chooses PRIOR or RT per token is evaluated EXACTLY offline (both arms are already scored per token). Triggers use only inference-admissible inputs: model plan, causal prior (v0/a0/yaw-rate at t0), v0, driving command, anchor index.
Q4a_gating.gates_multiplicity_note: 22 trigger variants were tried; picking the best of them is a selection the 6-fold CV (which protects only the threshold) does not correct for -- the best row is a HYPOTHESIS for a pre-registered re-test on other logs / navtest, not a result.

cell_gates.gate: fallback to PRIOR when v0 in [0,2)
fallback to PRIOR when v0 in [2,8.33)
fallback to PRIOR when v0 in [8.33,13.89)
fallback to PRIOR when v0 in >=13.89
fallback to PRIOR when command = left
fallback to PRIOR when command = straight
fallback to PRIOR when command = right
HYBRID: PRIOR on command=straight, RT on left/right

measured_partial_longitudinal_pull_RT_mi.what: RT keeps LEGAL's path and moves its progress a fixed fraction (1-g) toward the prior's; an existing, scored, partial 'longitudinal scale-down'
measured_partial_longitudinal_pull_RT_mi.note: bins use LEGAL's own plan (the thing being pulled); a bin is a post-hoc cut. Reads the SIGN of a longitudinal pull-to-prior where LEGAL over/under-drives.

measured_points_x100.reading: RT - LEGAL is ~0 on average (see headline RT_s0_minus_LEGAL_s0), so the existing progress re-timing neither fixes nor causes the gap; the gap is already present in LEGAL, i.e. in the model's residual on both axes.
